description: This file defines the DefaultBasicHealthCheckConfig class, which provides configuration settings for health checks within the system, including whether health checks are enabled and the interval between checks.

classes.name: DefaultBasicHealthCheckConfig
classes.description: A final class implementing BasicHealthCheckConfig and WithConfigPath to encapsulate health check configuration such as enabled status and interval.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultBasicHealthCheckConfig from a Config object, applying default settings based on a predefined config path.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether health checks are enabled based on the configuration.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration between health checks.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the configuration path string for this config.
